body: > Regarding caret and tilde, page 14 of the [GLSL ES spec](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenGL/specs/es/3.0/GLSL_ES_Specification_3.00.pdf) (under the preprocessor chapter) lists ^ as a valid bitwise XOR operator and ~ as a valid bitwise negation (invert bits) operator. Yeah, I incorrectly removed these operators. I will create a PR to return them. > Sorry if I don't understand this code at all, does this run only after macro expansion? This code applied only after `#if` and `#ifdef` operator. I don't think it may be used with them:

Yeah, I understand that the comma *operator* is not supported (thankfully, I hate that operator).
I just meant that it's good to double-check if removing comma won't interfere with it being used as a *separator* in macros (since calls can also appear after `#if...`), like:
```gdshader
#define plus(a, b) ((a) + (b))
#if plus(2, -2) == 0
// code here should be included
#endif
```
If this only runs after macros are already expanded, no issue.
